epic.description:
Research and evaluate three different gateway/architecture options for our system integration.

This epic tracks the investigation of:
1. Direct Connection Gateway
2. Aggregation Gateway
3. Hybrid Gateway Approach

Each option will be researched through dedicated stories with detailed sub-tasks for thorough analysis.

stories.description:
Investigate the direct connection gateway pattern where agents connect directly to backend services without intermediary layers.

Research Areas:
- Architecture patterns and best practices
- Performance characteristics
- Security implications
- Operational complexity
- Scalability considerations

Deliverables:
- Technical analysis document
- Pros/cons comparison
- Implementation considerations

subtasks.description:
Review existing architecture patterns and documentation for direct connection gateways.

Tasks:
- Research industry best practices
- Document common patterns
- Identify reference implementations
- Collect architectural diagrams

Assess the security model, authentication, and authorization for direct connection patterns.

Tasks:
- Review authentication mechanisms
- Analyze authorization patterns
- Identify security risks
- Document mitigation strategies

subtasks.summary: Assess Direct Connection Performance and Scalability
subtasks.description:
Evaluate the performance implications and scalability considerations of direct connection gateways.

Tasks:
- Analyze latency characteristics
- Review throughput capabilities
- Assess scaling patterns
- Document performance trade-offs

stories.description:
Investigate the aggregation gateway pattern where a centralized gateway aggregates and routes requests to backend services.

Research Areas:
- Gateway architecture patterns
- Request routing and aggregation
- Caching strategies
- Operational overhead
- Vendor coupling implications

Deliverables:
- Technical analysis document
- Pros/cons comparison
- Implementation considerations

subtasks.description:
Review existing architecture patterns and documentation for centralized aggregation gateways.

Tasks:
- Research gateway patterns (API Gateway, Service Mesh, etc.)
- Document aggregation strategies
- Identify reference implementations
- Collect architectural diagrams

Assess policy enforcement, rate limiting, and governance features of aggregation gateways.

Tasks:
- Review policy enforcement mechanisms
- Analyze rate limiting strategies
- Identify governance capabilities
- Document configuration patterns

Evaluate the observability, logging, and monitoring characteristics of aggregation gateways.

Tasks:
- Analyze logging capabilities
- Review metrics collection
- Assess tracing support
- Document monitoring strategies

stories.description:
Investigate a hybrid approach combining direct connections for specific use cases with aggregation for others.

Research Areas:
- Hybrid architecture patterns
- Use case segmentation
- Complexity management
- Migration strategies
- Operational considerations

Deliverables:
- Technical analysis document
- Pros/cons comparison
- Implementation roadmap

subtasks.description:
Review patterns that combine direct and aggregated connection strategies.

Tasks:
- Research hybrid gateway patterns
- Document decision criteria for connection type
- Identify reference implementations
- Collect architectural diagrams

Assess the operational complexity and management overhead of maintaining a hybrid gateway architecture.

Tasks:
- Analyze operational requirements
- Review maintenance overhead
- Identify complexity sources
- Document mitigation strategies

Create a migration strategy for adopting a hybrid gateway approach, including phasing and rollback plans.

Tasks:
- Define migration phases
- Identify migration risks
- Document rollback procedures
- Create adoption timeline
